text:
Noah: quick note — hit a reproducible circular wait in staging between prefetch workers and eviction sweeps under tight demote churn. stack gist posted.
Maya: drop the gist?
Noah: https://gist.github.com/repro-6167890000 (minimal trace + repro script)
Ibrahim: looks like two locks flip: shard mutex vs tenant mutex. options: (A) canonicalize order tenant->shard, (B) RPC handoff (TransferPrefix), (C) RW tenant lock (shared for prefetch, exclusive for eviction).
Zoe: important constraint: any change that expands prefetch critical section can regress tail latency. keep that in mind for ordering flips.
Rohit: RPC handoff seems operationally palatable: eviction issues TransferPrefix(req_id, tenant, prefix) and prefetch responds OK/BUSY. must include holder_epoch and make apply idempotent.
Maya: short-term mitigation: bounded-acquire timeout in eviction (X ms) — on timeout requeue with jitter/backoff. prevents full-system stall while we iterate.
Ibrahim: middle-ground: prefetch take tenant lock in read mode and eviction takes write. need safe upgrade (try_upgrade + backoff) to avoid upgrade deadlocks when multiple readers race to upgrade.
Noah: telemetry: add sampled "wait_chain" capture when goroutine blocks >10ms and a "transfer_handoff" metric with status codes and latencies.
Rohit: I'll draft proto + failure modes: prefetch crash mid-handoff, duplicate transfer, partial apply. plan: use holder_epoch and request_id to fence and reconcile.
Maya: I'll implement bounded-acquire canary and a staging alert: fail deploy if stall_rate > 0.05% over 15m.
Ibrahim: I'll prototype try-upgrade RW-lock with randomized backoff and unit tests simulating N concurrent upgraders.
Zoe: add a lint rule: any handoff code must include `// handoff-idempotent` comment and tests for the three failure classes.
handoff-bot: created INF-3001: "staging: prefetch-evict circular-wait" and INF-3002: "telemetry: wait_chain + transfer_handoff"
Noah: owners recap: Rohit proto + doc, Ibrahim RW-lock prototype, Maya bounded-acquire + canary, Zoe lint + review checklist. let's reconvene after benches.
Maya: will post bench CSVs and PR links here. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
